raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm, where `cutlass` is not installed, Inkling fails to start on main because `models/inkling_common/attn.py` imports `is_batch_invariant` from the CuTe flash-attention package at module level, outside the file's existing optional-CuTe `try`. Importing that package runs its `__init__`, which pulls in the FA4 interface and `cutlass`, so the module fails to import. The model registry only logs `Ignore import error when loading sglang.srt.models.inkling: No module named 'cutlass'` and skips the model, so startup later fails with an error that does not point at the cause.

The fix comes from sgl-project/sglang#37294, which is merged into the `sglang-miles` branch. That PR also fixed `SWAKVPool.get_v_head_dim()` for pools without full-attention layers; main has since fixed that independently, so after merging main this PR carries only the `attn.py` change.

## Modifications

- `attn.py`: move the `is_batch_invariant` import into the existing optional-CuTe `try`, set it to `None` when CuTe is unavailable, and guard its only use (the FA4 sheared-bias fast path) with `is not None`. With `cutlass` installed the same function is imported and the guard is always true, so the CUDA path is unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model outputs; this only decides whether Inkling can start on ROCm.

Validated on MI355X (gfx950) with the `rocm/sgl-dev:miles-rocm10-mi35x-20260929` image, whose SGLang is the `sglang-miles` commit this fix was based on. The `attn.py` lines there are identical to this PR; that image also carries #37294's own fix for the SWA issue, which main now handles independently.

- `import sglang.srt.models.inkling`: fails with `No module named 'cutlass'` before, succeeds after.
- After merging current main, on CPU without `cutlass`: importing Inkling fails with `No module named 'cutlass'` before and succeeds after. Pre-commit passes.
- Miles' `test_inkling_small_4layer_ci.py` (4 x MI355X, Triton attention), the Inkling test registered in Miles' AMD CI, passes with the fix: 2 rollouts and 8 train steps complete and the Ray job succeeds. Without it, this test currently times out at 2400 s in Miles' scheduled AMD CI.

Not run on NVIDIA GPUs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the change is on the model-load path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

A small test could set `sys.modules['cutlass'] = None`, import the module, and assert `is_batch_invariant is None` and that the sheared-bias branch is skipped.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers only: a future unguarded FA4 import could reintroduce the ROCm import failure without CI catching it.

@@ -6,9 +6,6 @@
 import torch
 from torch import nn
 
-from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attn.cute.batch_invariance import (
-    is_batch_invariant,
-)
 from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.score_mod import (
     relative_bias_score_mod as triton_relative_bias_score_mod,
 )
@@ -46,10 +43,14 @@
     import cutlass.cute as cute
     from cutlass.cute import Float32
 
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attn.cute.batch_invariance import (
+        is_batch_invariant,
+    )
     from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attn.cute.seqlen_info import SeqlenInfoQK
 except Exception as _import_error:
     cute = None
     Float32 = None
+    is_batch_invariant = None
     SeqlenInfoQK = None
     _cute_import_error = _import_error
 else:
@@ -930,6 +931,7 @@ def forward(
         if (
             envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_INKLING_SHEARED_BIAS.get()
             and fa4
+            and is_batch_invariant is not None
             and not is_batch_invariant()
         ):
             # FA4 sheared-bias kernel: pass rel_logits directly; the kernel shears
